info.name: Azure API Management REST API
info.description:
REST APIs for managing Azure API Management service instances and their entities including APIs, products, subscriptions, users, groups, policies, gateways, backends, certificates, and workspaces. Uses Azure Resource Manager conventions.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Azure
